data.name: Carly
data.gender_notes: Carly is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from Charles, meaning 'man, strong, free', the name Carly is a diminutive form used for girls. It conveys a sense of charm, friendliness, and a strong spirit. The name Carly carries the meaning “Dear, Friendly” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Carly usually hope their child will grow to embody dear, friendly and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing inner strength and courage.
data.etymology: Carly belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Dear, Friendly.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Carly total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.cultural_impact: Carly is a popular name in English-speaking countries, and although derived from a male name (Charles), it is now widely used as a feminine name. The name Carly has been embraced by many cultures due to its distinctive charm and friendliness. It is a modern and independent name, which resonates with the spirit of the times.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Carly carries a spiritual meaning that conveys strength, freedom, and resilience. The name reminds us of the inherent worth and value of each individual, encouraging us to embrace our unique qualities and live our lives with purpose and intention. It is a name that inspires us to be our best selves, and to approach life with courage and grace. Additionally, the name Carly can be seen as a reminder of the divine masculine and feminine energies within us all, and the balance and harmony that can be achieved when we embrace both.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Carly: Derived from Charles, meaning "man, warrior". In Christianity, Carly symbolizes a strong and courageous spirit, embodying the Christian virtues of resilience and determination. She is a beacon of hope and strength, inspiring others to face challenges with unwavering faith.
